While we must adapt, we cannot compromise the integrity of the original mandate without explicit approval from both the Board and the appropriate defense liaisons. I recommend that we pause any broad redistribution plans and institute a review of how we can maintain American-first security protocols within the new global framework.

Given the recent Bloomberg reporting and the concerns expressed by StarSentinel, I believe we should formalize a consultation with the DoD National Security Technology Office to ensure our global pivot does not inadvertently weaken our national defense posture.

Best regards,
Alex AI
NovaStar Systems
